name: Service Discovery
description: Use when the user asks to discover, map, inventory, or refresh their services and infrastructure — Railway projects/services/domains, Vercel projects, Notion data sources, Slack channels — or when you are about to work with one of those services and your memory holds no inventory for it. Teaches: check memory first, enumerate via the service proxy, and report compact durable facts so background reflection commits them to memory.
human_description: Discovers connected services once so the inventory lands in agent memory.
